description: Smallest end-to-end test of an x402 client on Base: one call with no required parameters returns server time (ISO 8601 and Unix ms), a request id, the seller payTo, chain id and an echo of your optional text, only after a real settlement. Use this when an agent needs to prove its payment flow works, measure round-trip latency or run a cheap scheduled canary against a live seller. No upstream, no model inference; paid round trip 1 to 2 s (settlement first). Free sample at /api/x402-ping/sample.

Trust & liveness check for one x402 resource URL: live 402 probe (never pays the target), terms, discovery-schema quality, catalog presence, diff. Use this when auditing an unfamiliar x402 endpoint before paying or relying on it.

Change detection for anything with a URL, built for monitoring loops: probe one x402 resource or web page WITHOUT paying it and answer BASELINE, UNCHANGED, or CHANGED with a field-by-field diff (price, asset, payTo, schema, page body) against the last check for that watch. Use this when an agent runs on a schedule and needs to know what changed before spending money or attention. Watch and pack state persist across redeploys on the service volume. Packs: $1 for 250 checks on one endpoint.
